custom_css: /* Slideshow banner button - bottom align (mobile + desktop fix) */.slideshow__slide .slideshow__text-wrapper {display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; align-items: center; text-align: center;}
/* Desktop pe center fix */@media screen and (min-width: 750px) {.slideshow__slide .slideshow__text-wrapper {justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; }}
/* Mobile pe center fix */@media screen and (max-width: 749px) {.slideshow__slide .slideshow__text-wrapper {justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; }}
